FN-BYEFPJ4-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 444
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
House Bill 444 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Agriculture
and Industries by an undetermined amount dependent upon the associated costs to test certain
seafood for the accuracy of its labeled country of origin and report any violations to the State
Health Officer, as provided in the bill.
